title: Regression of #84: DSAR erasure is marked completed while nothing is erased for storefront customers
comment on #84
A verified DSAR access request is never fulfilled (ACCESS delivery not implemented)
Revoking a manager's last shop grant silently makes him tenant-wide Group admin
Every staff login is a tenant-wide Group admin by default (JIT provisioning, strict-scoping off)
A buyer of one shop can publish a 5-star review on a different shop of the same tenant

comment on #88
Checkout never re-validates the stored basket: stale prices, removed and sold-out items surface only as a charge or a bare error
The customer's allergen acknowledgement is never sent to or stored by the server
The customer never sees the allergen set recorded on their order, and it can differ from what they acknowledged
The kitchen screen ticket hides the customer's note (e.g. 'severe peanut allergy') and the fulfilment type
A product whose ingredients name an allergen (e.g. 'butter (MILK)') with no box ticked saves and shows as 'No allergens'
Shops go live with a failed FSA match, self-approved by the vendor, while the site claims 'UK food-hygiene verified'

No merchant terms, pricing page, VAT basis or card-fee figure: /legal/terms, /pricing, /contact and /about all 404

An order taken by an AI agent through MCP stays DRAFT and the kitchen never sees it
/sync/batch has no stock or availability field and silently skips unknown items while reporting SUCCESS

Asked for one shop's menu, an AI agent gets every product in the business with allergens only as an integer
Anyone can place many fake cash orders in seconds with throwaway contact details
Item quantity has no upper bound: a £19 billion order is accepted and shown on the dashboard

Kitchen mute survives sign-out and the next person's icon shows sound on while new orders are silent
Cancelling an order is one unconfirmed tap with no reason, next to Confirm on small phone buttons
Unanswered orders stay Pending forever and the customer is never told
Orders and Customers have no search, so an order cannot be found by customer name at the counter
Every kitchen ticket cuts the order number to 'ORD-…', so tickets look identical
The kitchen board is not built for a wall tablet: wasted space, small text, newest-first ordering and very tall tickets
No ready-by or delivery time exists anywhere: tickets, confirmation, tracking or emails
Order confirmation and every status email omit the shop, items, total and address, and come from inconsistent senders
Finance has no 'today', no date range, no export and no cash/card split
A completed cash order stays 'Payment status NONE / Unpaid' while counted as revenue
Cash-only is revealed only at the bottom of checkout, and the Place order button shows a card icon

The DSAR confirmation link does not open on compose and shows raw JSON when it does
The cookie policy omits keys that hold the customer's email and id and survive sign-out
Order contact details are barely validated, and API/MCP orders need no customer contact at all
Vendors have no bulk-reject and no fraud signal for junk orders
